# 7kasif (Hafte Kasif)

> 7kasif is a web application built with a TypeScript monorepo architecture. Packages include a shared library, a Node.js server, and a React client.

## Stack

- TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces)
- Node.js server, React client
- PostgreSQL database
- Docker for local development
